content: Christ asai Jounjauwaj
Ngoahi insingwehng kamwai, noai jerihkan, pwa kamwai en joah wia dihp. A ma emen pirin wiahda dihp, asai Jounjauwajjo mine ipen Koahs, ioar Jesus Christ, pwa Ih ma pwung.
Pwa Christ ma ne dupukda dipasai kan, a jaudi dipasaioar, pwa pel dipen armaj nehn jampah ohroj.
Ma kisai kin peikkoang en Koahs kojonned kan, kajalehda mehlel in asai kidal Ih.
A ma kisai pwa, “Kisai kidal Ih,” a johpwa kin peikkoang Ah kojonned kan, kisai armaj likamw pwi, apel mehlel johpwa mine ipasai.
A ma kisai kin peikkoang Ah Mahjan, a ioar asai limpoak oang Koahs ne unjekla. Ioar joang oauwe ma kisai kak en kidal mehlel in asai minmin oang Koahs:
Ma kisai pwa kisai kin minmin oang Koahs, a kisai en mourki mourro ma Jesus ne mourki.
Kojonned Kapw

Oai pirien kajampwal kan, kojonned oauwe ma ngoahi insingkihwehng kamwai jaudi kojonned kapw oau. Pwa ioar kojonnedwahr kamwai ne oaloa jang in sapdahu, apel ioar kojonnedwahr ma padahk in kamwai ne rong.
Doari, kojonned oauwe ma ngoahi insingkihwehng kamwai apkas pwen kapw, pwa mehlel in kojonned oauwe ne janjaljang ipen Christ apel ipamwai. Pwa ros ne johjohrla, apel maram mehlel ne dakda.
Ma kisai pwa kisai minmine nehn maram, a lioassoang riasai, pein kisai minmine nehn ros lel anjoau kije.
Ma kisai ipwilki riasai kan, kisai minminehr nehn maram; doari, johpwa mehkij nauna ipasai ma pirin kahrehioang emen sohrohr nehn dihp.
A ma kisai lioassoang riasai kan, kisai minminehr nehn ros; kisai kin wud nehn ros, apel kisai jehjoa wija ma kisai kin aluhwoang, pwa rosso kin karosihla mijasai kan.
Ngoahi insingwehng kamwai, noai jerihkan, pwa mahk in dipamwai kan ne lapwkihda oadoan Christ.
Ngoahi insingwehng kamwai, jahm kan, pwa amwai kidal Ih ma kin mine janngoar in sapdahu. Ngoahi insingwehng kamwai, mwahnkapw kan, pwa amwai ne kalwehdi Me Naunahu.

Ngoahi insingwehng kamwai noai jerihkan, pwa amwai kidal Jahmmo. Ngoahi insingwehng kamwai, jahm kan, pwa amwai kidal Ih janngoar in sapdahu, Ngoahi insingwehng kamwai, mwahnkapw kan, pwa amwai sihkei. Mahjan in Koahs kin minmine nehn mohngiongimwai kan, apel kamwai ne kalwehdi Me Naunahu.
Kamwai joah ipwilki jampah, ke dipwjoau kan ma minmine nehn jampah. Pwa ma kamwai kin ipwilki jampah, ipwilki Jahmmo johpwa mine ipamwai.

Pwa mehpwiai ohroj kijehn jampah; dipen inoang in uduk, apel mehkan ma armaj kin kapang apel anahnehda, apel meohroj ma mine nehn jampah ma armaj kin kamjehkkihda — mehpwiai ohroj johpwa injang ipen Jahmmo, irai ohroj injang nehn jampah.
Jampah oauwe apel meohroj nehn jampah ma armaj kin anahnehda kin johjohrla; a armajjok ma kin kapwaihahda kupwuren Koahs pirin mour allaluhlahr.
Imwinsihsihn Christ
Noai jeri kan, imwin anjoau ne koaroando! Kamwai ne rong pwa imwinsihsihn Christ pirin indoa. Doar apkas, imwinsihsi dir ne pwokda; ioar ma kisai kidalki pwa imwin anjoau ne koaroando.

Armaj pwiai jaudi uhdahn ioangoasai; ma kahrehda irai ne mweijang kisai. Pwa ma ioangoasai irai, irai pirin minminehr ipasai. A irai ne mweijang kisai pwa en janjalda pwa johpwa emen irai ma uhdahn ioangoasai.
A kamwai ne oaloa Ngen Joarwi ma Christ ne kamwroahdi pohmwaikan. Doari kamwai ohroj ken kidalla me mehlello.
Ngoahi insingwehng kamwai, jaudi pwa amwai jehjoa me mehlello, a pwa kamwai pwen kidal. Apel kamwai kidal pwa likamw johpwa kin injang in me mehlello.
Inje ma kin likamw? Ioar iraihok, ma kin sikoa pwa Jesus jaudi Christ
. Armaj pwiok, ioar imwinsihsihn Christ — pein irai kahmahmkihla Jahmmo apel Nah Iehrojjo.
Pwa armajjok ma kin kahmahmki Nah Iehrojjo pel kin kahmahmki Jahmmo; a armajjok ma kin kamehlele Nah Iehrojjo pel kin kamehlele Jahmmo.
Kamwai mweidoahng padahkko ma kamwai ne rong in sapdahu en soangdi nehn amwai mohngiong kan. Pwa ma kamwai kolkolloar padahkko, amwai mour pirin minmin oang Nah Iehrojjo apel Jahmmo anjoau ohroj.
Doari, me ioar ma Christ ne inoaukihdi pwa en kioang kisai — mour joahsuk.
Ngoahi insingkihwehng kamwai apkas, doahr irai kan ma kin jongjong in kapweipweidi kamwai.

A kamwai, Christ ne widekihdihoang pohmwaikan Ngenin. Oaroain Ngenin pirin minmine nehn mohngiongimwai kan, johpwa anahne emen sohrohr en padahkihoang kamwai mehkij, pwa Ngenno kin padahkihoang kamwai doahr meohroj, apel da ma Ih pel padahkihoang kamwai, ioar ma mehlel, jaudi likamw. Kamwai peikkoang padahk in Ngenno apel minmin oang Christ.
Eh, noai jeri kan, minmin oang Ih, ma Ih pirin pwokda, pwa kisai en uhdahn eimah, apel johpwa pirin mehk, oakla nehn rehnno ma Ih pirin indoa.
Kamwai ne kidal pwa Christ ma pwung; kamwai en pel kidal pwa irai ohroj ma kin wia me pwung, ioar irai nihn Koahs.
